name: PHerc0841 (unseen scroll; map + human labels)
summary: Native 9.37 µm / 113 keV surface volume; Reader V3, Reader v2 and dense_native 16k (the ink_9um labels contain no PHerc0841). Two references: the team's 2.4 µm ink map (117 strokes, used for node A) and the human ink labels (level 4, 9.6 µm; independent of any model, but they merge into only 7 connected strokes, too few for a letter-level verdict on their own). No PHerc0841 segment is in Reader V3's or Reader v2's training list (checked in the configs embedded in reader-v3.pth and reader-v2-step040000.pth): an unseen scroll.

references.name: 2.4 µm map
references.kind: team model prediction on a 4× finer scan

references.name: human labels
references.kind: hand-drawn ink labels, independent of any model

headline: Reader V3, Reader v2 and dense_native all see 0841 ink (significant against the 2.4 µm map and the human labels) but not at letter level (WEAK: best stroke recall 0.34 vs 0.15 chance), on a scroll none of them trained on.
